items.title: WHO intensifies Ebola-curbing efforts through drug trial and diagnostic rollout
items.summary: WHO is sponsoring a trial testing drugs for Bundibugyo virus, while adding the first Ebola diagnostic test to its emergency use list.

items.title: US-UK pharma trade deal paints a costly economic picture for NHS
items.summary: Financial research published in the BMJ shows the trade deal could end up costing the NHS tens of billions.

items.title: SK bioscience to lead Gates Foundation-funded ROTOR project
items.summary: SK bioscience is set to lead the Gates Foundation-funded ROTOR project, an AI-based platform aimed at reducing uncertainty in vaccine-development decisions.

items.title: The celebrity prescription: star power meets healthcare
items.summary: Celebrity ambassadors in pharma and medtech herald a new dawn of direct-to-consumer advertising.

items.title: European Commission approves Novartis’ Itvisma to treat SMA
items.summary: The EC has granted approval for Novartis’ Itvisma as a treatment for children two years and older, teenagers, and adults who have 5q SMA with a bi-allelic mutation in the SMN1 gene.
